gen-dafont-franchise-gf-marcellus-sc: Dignified Marcellus SC sets the tone with a gentle, literary lilt. Franchise hits back with tall, tightly packed letters of uniform line weight, and that clash of blunt and swelling strokes is the strongest thing here.
gen-dafont-franchise-gf-ovo: Ovo reads with classic authority, its thin strokes only a shade lighter than the thick ones. But Franchise, jammed tight with no weight swing, leaves Ovo's open curve endings to carry text page after page.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-kadwa: Cosmic and commanding, Galaxy draws each stroke as stout as a pipe cleaner. Kadwa brings open-ended curves and a larger x-height, a gentle serif counterweight to that dense, stout heading.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-hedvig-letters-seri: Hedvig Letters Serif is a classic serif with sturdy, tall lowercase and soft, ink-drawn modulation. And Gobold's monotone line and widely spread letters let the body's open curves make pages of text feel unhurried.
gen-dafont-gobold-gf-noto-serif-hentaiga: Noto Serif Hentaigana reads refined and traditional, a classic serif with quiet shifts in line weight. And Gobold's drafting-pen line gives text a firm start before the body's tall small letters take over.
gen-dafont-good-times-fs-asap: Good Times brings a commanding, geometric heading with an open e. Asap keeps text moving smoothly, its open-arc c forms and near-capital lowercase height holding up line after line.
gen-dafont-good-times-fs-epilogue: Thick, cable-like small letters define Good Times. Where Good Times delivers punch with its subtly graded curves, Epilogue's friendly, wire-like monoline lowercase does the patient work of carrying text.
gen-dafont-good-times-fs-merriweather-sa: Good Times is thick and geometric, its e opening with a clear gap. Merriweather Sans makes long text feel sturdy, helped by tall lowercase forms and an e whose eye opens rightward.
gen-dafont-good-times-fs-supreme: Chunky, cable-thick letters up top, then Supreme's crisp text below. Good Times excels at commanding, geometric shapes with moderate modulation, while Supreme holds its heavy-looking text strip open and crisp.
gen-dafont-good-times-manrope: Manrope reads bright and approachable, with open mouths on every curve. Good Times adds a commanding, moderately contrasted heading, and Manrope's single-width pen line keeps the page friendly beneath it.
